messages:
Kevin (Partnerships): Heads up — HW partner wants to bundle the new on-prem appliance with a marketplace private offer for migration credits. Need alignment on split, announcement timing, and renewal anchor.
Maria (SalesEng): Quick q — is the migration credit applied to marketplace consumption only, or can it offset reserved capacity / dedicated?
Olivia (Finance): Prefer marketplace-only for bookkeeping, but we can create an internal rebate flow for reserved credits. Does partner expect 50/50 split?
Laura (HW Partner): We were thinking 40% marketplace credits, 60% appliance discount. Goal is to reduce buyer friction for on-prem migration. Announcement ideally close to next quarter launch.
Sanjay (CloudPM): For cross-cloud appliance SKUs, we need SKU parity across AWS/Azure/GCP listings. Otherwise the private offer won't map cleanly. I can share mapping sheet.
Kevin (Partnerships): Link to working sheet: https://tinyurl.com/appliance-credits — please edit 'Partner Split' column. We need final numbers by EOD Thu to make the partner PR plan.
Maria (SalesEng): For renewals, can we anchor the renewal at list consumption minus credits? That avoids customers thinking credits are recurring. We should document in PO terms.
Olivia (Finance): Yes — credits are one-time migration credits. Renewal anchor = pre-credit ARR baseline. I'll draft wording for PO appendix.
Laura (HW Partner): One ask: can we have a modest co-marketing fund that scales with committed spend? e.g., 2% of committed marketplace usage credited to co-marketing.
Kevin (Partnerships): That sounds reasonable. We should bake that into the private-offer term sheet. Can legal ops draft a 1-pager?
Sanjay (CloudPM): Technical: marketplace SKU mapping snippet (please confirm):
```
APPL-PRO-1 -> MKT-APPL-PRO-2026
APPL-EDGE-4 -> MKT-APPL-EDGE-2026
APPL-CORE-XL -> MKT-APPL-CORE-XL-2026
```
Kevin (Partnerships): Confirmed. Also ordering flow: customer redeems private offer code during checkout, credits appear as line-item 'Migration Credit' and reduce net payable. For reserved capacity we will record rebate separately.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: private-offer creation window closes in 72h if partner terms aren't approved.
Maria (SalesEng): Action items: 1) Olivia to draft PO appendix (due Fri) 2) Laura to confirm co-marketing % and cap 3) Sanjay to finalize SKU mapping in sheet 4) Kevin to prep joint announcement timeline.
Olivia (Finance): Draft started — will push to sheet and ping legal.
Laura (HW Partner): Will confirm percentage and proposed cap by tomorrow morning.
Sanjay (CloudPM): Updated mapping in sheet. Left a note about region-specific SKUs.
Kevin (Partnerships): Perfect. If we lock numbers by EOD Thu we can target a soft announcement + partner blog week of next month. Otherwise push to next quarter. :calendar:
Maria (SalesEng): 👍 thanks everyone.
Kevin (Partnerships): Closing loop later today with combined term sheet.
